## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed: ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, plus 1/12 and 1/16 as decimals. Three data points now. Plot them at the end of the month, not today.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Expectation by indicators, which is the trick behind half of the canon: shuffle a deck of 52 cards. What is the expected number of cards in their original position? Get it in one line using linearity, then say why the answer does not depend on the deck size.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The follow-up they ask: what is the probability that no card is in its original position, and what number does it approach? You should recognise this one; state the limit and where it comes from.
:::
:::
